declaration.preface: At Rakheja Enterprises LLP, we are committed to maintaining the highest standards of corporate governance. We ensure transparency, accountability, and integrity in all our operations and decision-making processes. Our governance policy emphasizes ethical behaviour, compliance with laws and regulations, and effective stakeholder engagement to foster trust and sustainability. We prioritize open communication channels and continuous improvement to uphold our commitment to good governance practices.
declaration.declaration:
Ethical Conduct: Ensure all business activities are conducted ethically and in compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Transparency: Maintain transparency in our operations, financial reporting, and decision-making processes.

Accountability: Hold all levels of the organization accountable for their actions and decisions.

Stakeholder Engagement: Foster active engagement with stakeholders to understand their concerns and expectations.

Risk Management: Identify, assess, and manage risks effectively to safeguard the company’s assets and reputation.

Compliance: Ensure compliance with corporate governance principles and standards set by regulatory bodies.
declaration.scope: This Policy applies to all employees (at all levels), all stakeholders, partners, contractors, customers, suppliers, and any other individual or entity working on behalf of Rakheja Enterprises LLP. It also applies to all our manufacturing facilities.

Corruption: We have implemented the Compliance Management System (CMS) with robust monitoring and auditing processes.
We look to our Anti-Corruption Compliance Team and regular risk assessments using Ethical Risk Assessment Tools.
We have conducted mandatory annual training sessions using Scenario-Based Training Platforms, focusing on real-world scenarios and ethical decision-making.
Conflict of Interest: We have utilized the Conflict-of-Interest Management System (CIMS) with a robust reporting system.
We look to our Online Conflict Reporting Portal and Ethics Committee to review disclosures and provide guidance.
We have conducted quarterly compliance reviews using the Compliance Review Tracker and updated processes annually based on best practices and employee feedback.
Money Laundering: We have enhanced AML controls with Real-Time Transaction Monitoring Systems and rigorous due diligence procedures.
We look to our Bi-Annual AML Audits conducted by an external firm.
We have introduced the Whistleblower Hotline System to ensure accessibility for anonymous reporting of suspicious activities.
Data Manipulation: We have established robust data integrity systems with Advanced Encryption Technologies and Regular Data Audits.
We look to our Quarterly Data Integrity Reviews involving cross-departmental teams and Sophisticated Monitoring Tools.
We have addressed data discrepancies promptly with Comprehensive Review Processes and Automated Issue Resolution Systems.
Anti-Competitive Practices: We have implemented a comprehensive compliance framework with Market Behaviour Monitoring Systems and Employee Training Platforms.
We look to our Compliance Monitoring Unit to oversee market practices and provide real-time guidance.
We have ensured employee participation in training on fair competition laws using Interactive Training Modules.
Fraud: We have deployed Advanced Fraud Detection Systems like Predictive Analytics Software and Anomaly Detection Technologies.
We look to our Quarterly Fraud Risk Assessments using Sophisticated Analytical Tools.
We have established a Fraud Prevention Task Force to review incidents and refine detection strategies using Fraud Analysis Platforms.
Information Security Management: We have enhanced information security with Multi-Factor Authentication Systems and Intrusion Detection Systems.
We look to our Annual Information Security Training Programs including Practical Incident Response Simulations.
We have performed regular security audits and penetration tests using Advanced Security Testing Tools.
Reporting: Transparent and regular reporting is crucial for monitoring the effectiveness of our governance framework, ensuring accountability, and driving continuous improvement. Rakheja Enterprises LLP implements the following reporting procedures:

We conduct annual evaluations of our governance practices, gathering data on key metrics outlined in our Governance Strategy. These reports include an assessment of compliance with governance standards and progress towards our policy objectives.

We perform internal audits to evaluate adherence to governance policies and procedures, assess the effectiveness of our governance management systems, and identify areas requiring corrective action. These audits help ensure ongoing compliance and facilitate continuous improvement.

We actively engage with stakeholders, including employees, board members, investors, and regulators, to solicit feedback, address concerns, and communicate our governance practices and performance. This engagement ensures transparency and fosters a collaborative approach to governance issues.

We provide accessible channels for employees and stakeholders to report governance-related violations or concerns. Reports are reviewed promptly, and actions are taken to resolve issues and prevent recurrence. This mechanism supports our commitment to accountability and continuous improvement.

We enhance transparency by publicly disclosing our governance performance, including progress towards policy objectives and responses to stakeholder concerns. These disclosures are made through our website, annual reports, and other communication channels, ensuring that our commitments are visible and accessible.

We regularly review and update our governance policy based on performance reports, audit findings, and stakeholder feedback. This ensures that the policy remains relevant, effective, and aligned with best practices and evolving governance standards.
Consequences for Violation of this Polic: At Rakheja Enterprises LLP, we take violations of our governance policy very seriously. All employees and stakeholders are expected to adhere strictly to the principles outlined in this policy. Failure to comply with the governance policy will result in appropriate disciplinary actions and measures to address the breach.

Violations of the governance policy by employees may result in disciplinary actions ranging from formal warnings to suspension or termination of employment, depending on the severity and nature of the breach. Repeat offenses or serious violations will be treated with increased severity.

Serious breaches involving management or senior executives may lead to removal from their positions, legal action, and termination of employment. The company will conduct thorough investigations to determine the appropriate course of action.

Any violations involving illegal activities such as fraud, corruption, or money laundering will be reported to the relevant authorities. Legal proceedings may be initiated, and individuals involved may face criminal charges, fines, and imprisonment as applicable under the law.

Contractors and suppliers who violate the governance policy may face financial penalties, including termination of contracts, loss of business, and legal action to recover damages. We will ensure that contractual agreements include provisions for compliance and penalties for breaches.

In addition to disciplinary actions, we will implement corrective measures to address the root cause of the violation. This may include additional training, process improvements, and revisions to policies and procedures to prevent future occurrences.

Violations of the governance policy may lead to reputational damage for the company and individuals involved. We will take steps to mitigate any negative impact and restore trust through transparent communication and corrective actions.

Individuals subject to disciplinary actions have the right to appeal decisions through established grievance mechanisms. We will review appeals fairly and impartially, ensuring that all parties have an opportunity to present their case.
Continuous Improvement: At Rakheja Enterprises LLP, we are committed to continuous improvement in our governance practices. We actively seek feedback from stakeholders, including employees, partners, and regulatory bodies, to identify areas for enhancement. Our approach includes regular performance assessments and benchmarking against industry standards to ensure we meet and exceed best practices. We prioritize the integration of lessons learned from internal audits, risk assessments, and external reviews into our governance framework. By fostering a culture of open communication and accountability, we encourage proactive identification and resolution of governance issues. Our commitment to continuous improvement drives us to refine our policies, update training programs, and adopt innovative solutions to enhance transparency, accountability, and ethical conduct across all levels of the organization.
